report.summary: The alert hypothesizes coordinated accumulation, and the investigation agrees. All four accounts (C001, C003, C005, C006) share a common funding source FC1 [c1]. All 23 trades executed by these ring members in market M12 were BUY orders [c2], occurring within a 2 hour and 25 minute window [c3]. This shared funding source and synchronized BUY-side trading activity across all accounts in market M12 indicate coordinated accumulation, consistent with policy SP-2.2 [c4].
